4.t: and ˹the angels˺ administering affairs by ˹Allah’s˺ command

5.t: Indeed, what you are promised is true

6.t: And the Judgment will certainly come to pass

7.t: ˹And˺ by the heavens in their marvellous design

8.t: Surely you are ˹lost˺ in conflicting views ˹regarding the truth˺

9.t: Only those ˹destined to be˺ deluded are turned away from it

11.t: those who are ˹steeped˺ in ignorance, totally heedless

12.t: They ask ˹mockingly˺, “When is this Day of Judgment?”

13.t: ˹It is˺ the Day they will be tormented over the Fire

14.t: ˹They will be told,˺ “Taste your torment! This is what you sought to hasten.”
14.tr: Zooqoo fitnatakum haa-zal lazee kuntum bihee tas-ta'jiloon

15.t: Indeed, the righteous will be amid Gardens and springs

16.t: ˹joyfully˺ receiving what their Lord will grant them. Before this ˹reward˺ they were truly good-doers ˹in the world˺
16.tr: Aakhizeena maaa aataahum Rabbuhum; innahum kaanoo qabla zaalika muhsineen

17.t: they used to sleep only little in the night
17.tr: kaanoo qaleelam minal laili maa yahja'oon

18.t: and pray for forgiveness before dawn

19.t: And in their wealth there was a rightful share ˹fulfilled˺ for the beggar and the poor

20.t: There are ˹countless˺ signs on earth for those with sure faith

21.t: as there are within yourselves. Can you not see

22.t: In heaven is your sustenance and whatever you are promised

23.t: Then by the Lord of heaven and earth! ˹All˺ this is certainly as true as ˹the fact that˺ you can speak
23.tr: Fawa-Rabbis samaaa'i wal-ardi innahoo lahaqqum misla maa annakum tantiqoon

24.t: Has the story of Abraham’s honoured guests reached you ˹O Prophet˺
24.tr: Hal ataaka hadeesu daifi Ibraaheemal mukrameen

25.t: ˹Remember˺ when they entered his presence and greeted ˹him with˺, “Peace!” He replied, “Peace ˹be upon you˺!” ˹Then he said to himself,˺ “˹These are˺ an unfamiliar people.”
25.tr: Iz dakhaloo 'alaihi faqaaloo salaaman qaala salaamun qawmum munkaroon

26.t: Then he slipped off to his family and brought a fat ˹roasted˺ calf
26.tr: Faraagha ilaaa ahlihee fajaaa'a bi'ijlin sameen

27.t: and placed it before them, asking, “Will you not eat?”

28.t: ˹They did not eat,˺ so he grew fearful of them. They reassured ˹him˺, “Do not be afraid,” and gave him good news of a knowledgeable son
28.tr: Fa-awjasa minhum khee-fatan qaaloo laa takhaf Wa-bashsharoohu bighulaamin 'aleem

29.t: Then his wife came forward with a cry, clasping her forehead ˹in astonishment˺, exclaiming, “˹A baby from˺ a barren, old woman!”
29.tr: Fa-aqbalatim ra-atuhoo fee sarratin fasakkat wajhahaa Wa-qaalat 'ajoozun 'aqeem

30.t: They replied, “Such has your Lord decreed. He is truly the All-Wise, All-Knowing.”
30.tr: Qaaloo kazaaliki qaala Rabbuki innahoo huwal hakeemul 'aleem

31.t: ˹Later,˺ Abraham asked, “What is your mission, O messengers?”

32.t: They replied, “We have actually been sent to a wicked people
32.tr: Qaalooo innaaa ursilnaaa ilaa qawmim mujrimeen

33.t: to send upon them stones of ˹baked˺ clay

34.t: marked by your Lord for the transgressors.”

35.t: Then ˹before the torment˺ We evacuated the believers from the city
35.tr: Fa-akhrajnaa man kaana feehaa minal mu'mineen

36.t: But We only found one family that had submitted ˹to Allah˺
36.tr: Famaa wajadnaa feehaa ghaira baitim minal muslimeen

37.t: And We have left a sign there ˹as a lesson˺ for those who fear the painful punishment
37.tr: Wa-taraknaa feehaaa aayatal lillazeena yakhaafoonal 'azaabal aleem

38.t: And in ˹the story of˺ Moses ˹was another lesson,˺ when We sent him to Pharaoh with compelling proof
38.tr: Wa-fee Moosaaa iz arsalnaahu ilaa Fir'awna bisultaa-nim mubeen

39.t: but Pharaoh was carried away by his power, saying ˹of Moses˺, “A magician or a madman!”
39.tr: Fatawalla biruknihee Wa-qaala saahirun aw majnoon

40.t: So We seized him and his soldiers, casting them into the sea while he was blameworthy
40.tr: Fa-akhaznaahu Wa-junoo-dahoo fanabaznaahum fil yammi Wa-huwa muleem

41.t: And in ˹the story of˺ ’Âd ˹was another lesson,˺ when We sent against them the devastating wind

42.t: There was nothing it came upon that it did not reduce to ashes
42.tr: Maa tazaru min shai'in atat 'alaihi illaa ja'alat-hu karrameem

43.t: And in ˹the story of˺ Thamûd ˹was another lesson,˺ when they were told, “Enjoy yourselves ˹only˺ for a ˹short˺ while.”
43.tr: Wa-fee Samooda iz qeela lahum tamatta''oo hattaa heen

44.t: Still they persisted in defying the commands of their Lord, so they were overtaken by a ˹mighty˺ blast while they were looking on
44.tr: Fa'ataw 'an amri Rabbihim fa-akhazal-humus saa'iqatu Wa-hum yanzuroon

45.t: Then they were not able to rise up, nor were they helped
45.tr: Famas tataa'oo min qiyaaminw Wa-maa kaanoo muntasireen

46.t: And the people of Noah ˹had also been destroyed˺ earlier. They were truly a rebellious people
46.tr: Wa-qawma Noohim min qablu innahum kaano qawman faasiqeen

47.t: We built the universe with ˹great˺ might, and We are certainly expanding ˹it˺

48.t: As for the earth, We spread it out. How superbly did We smooth it out

49.t: And We created pairs of all things so perhaps you would be mindful
49.tr: Wa-min kulli shai'in khalaqnaa zawjaini la'allakum tazakkaroon

50.t: So ˹proclaim, O Prophet˺: “Flee to Allah! I am truly sent by Him with a clear warning to you
50.tr: Fafirrooo ilal laahi innee lakum minhu nazeerum mubeen

51.t: And do not set up another god with Allah. I am truly sent by Him with a clear warning to you.”
51.tr: Wa-laa taj'aloo ma'al laahi ilaahan aakhara innee lakum minhu nazeerum mubeen

52.t: Similarly, no messenger came to those before them without being told: “A magician or a madman!”
52.tr: Kazaalika maaa atal lazeena min qablihim mir Rasoolin illaa qaaloo saahirun aw majnoon

53.t: Have they passed this ˹cliché˺ down to one another? In fact, they have ˹all˺ been a transgressing people
53.tr: Atawaasaw bih; bal hum qawmun taaghoon

54.t: So ˹now˺ turn away from them ˹O Prophet˺, for you will not be blamed

55.t: But ˹continue to˺ remind. For certainly reminders benefit the believers

56.t: I did not create jinn and humans except to worship Me
56.tr: Wa-maa khalaqtul jinna wal-insa illaa liya'budoon

57.t: I seek no provision from them, nor do I need them to feed Me
57.tr: Maaa ureedu minhum mir rizqinw Wa-maaa ureedu aien yut'imoon

58.t: Indeed, Allah ˹alone˺ is the Supreme Provider—Lord of all Power, Ever Mighty
58.tr: Innal laaha Huwar Razzaaqu Zul Quwwatil Mateen

59.t: The wrongdoers will certainly have a share ˹of the torment˺ like that of their predecessors. So do not let them ask Me to hasten ˹it˺
59.tr: Fa-inna lillazeena zalamoo zanoobam misla zanoobi ashaabihim falaa yasta'jiloon

60.t: Woe then to the disbelievers when they face their Day which they are warned of
60.tr: Fawailul lillazeena kafaroo mien yawmihimul lazee yoo'adoon
